disclaimer: Vendor-published, unaudited aggregates, mostly subscription billing on cards in US/EU markets. Not a dataset and not specific to Razorpay/UPI. Used only as reality-check targets.

failure_mix.stat: Insufficient funds share of all subscription payment failures
failure_mix.source: Churnkey-Stripe dataset (5M+ failed subscription charges), as quoted by Juspay

failure_mix.stat: 'Do not honor' share of subscription payment failures
failure_mix.source: Churnkey-Stripe dataset, as quoted by Juspay

failure_mix.stat: 'Do not honor' share of 1,168,245 failed B2C subscription payments (2025-early 2026)
Declines caused by insufficient funds or 'do not honor' combined

recovery_rates.stat: Recovery of involuntary failures using Stripe's recovery suite (200+ audited B2C accounts)
Recurly B2C recovery rate (as cited by Redux)

recovery_rates.source: Stripe (vendor claim, as cited by Redux)

recovery_rates.stat: Enterprise recovery before -> after optimised retry strategies
Recovery of 'do not honor' declines with intelligent retries

timing.stat: Share of recovered transactions recovered within 10 days of the failure

calibration_band.note: Range spanning audited B2C figures (25-35%) up to the highest vendor claim (55%). The conservative world is calibrated so the rules baseline lands inside it.
